articles.summary: Credera , the transformation consulting firm of Omnicom (NYSE: OMC) , today announced a five-year strategic collaboration agreement (SCA) with Amazon Web Services, Inc. (AWS) to help enterprise brands accelerate marketing transformation, modernize infrastructure, and deploy AI into production while combining Credera's technical delivery depth and Omnicom's enterprise client relationships, proprietary identity data, connected media expertise, all powered by AWS. The resulting solutions can be fully integrated with Omni, Omnicom's next-generation AI-powered marketing and sales intelligence platform. Credera will target six priority verticals Consumer Packaged Goods, Energy, Healthcare and Life Sciences, Automotive, Public Sector, and Media and Entertainment across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. articles.title: Omnicom's Credera Announces Five-Year Strategic Collaboration with AWS to Transform Enterprise Marketing with AI and Cloud

articles.summary: Omnicom (NYSE: OMC) will publish its third quarter 2026 results on Thursday, October 22, 2026 after the New York Stock Exchange close of trading. The company will also host a conference call to review such financial results on Thursday, October 22, 2026, starting at 4:30 p.m. Eastern Time. A live webcast of the call will be available at Omnicom's investor relations website, investor.omc.com , along with the related earnings press release and slide presentation. A webcast replay will be made available after the call concludes. About Omnicom Omnicom (NYSE: OMC) is the world's leading marketing and sales company. Powered by Omni, its proprietary data and identity platform, Omnicom's Connected Capabilities unite the company's agency brands, talent, and domain expertise across media, commerce, consulting, precision marketing, advertising, production, health, public relations, branding, and experiential to address clients' most critical growth priorities.
